title: Required geometry and measurement metadata remain incomplete
root_cause: PO measurements cover major envelopes but pocket depth radii datums methods repetitions and uncertainty remain incomplete
solution: Confirm the remaining geometry and record a complete sanitized evidence package

title: Production print profile is not approved
root_cause: The Bambu Lab A1 is identified but material layer support compensation and instance configuration remain provisional
solution: Validate the proposed settings through separately authorized coupons before production use

title: Character intellectual-property risk
root_cause: Commercial-use rights and an independently designed mascot have not been established
solution: Develop an original mascot without recognizable Pikachu features and complete visual similarity review; keep publication blocked

title: IP68 claim does not establish charging suitability
root_cause: The simulation dataset includes water resistance without evidence applicable to charging
solution: Obtain manufacturer guidance or PO-confirmed test evidence before making a charging-suitability claim

title: Supplier claims lack source provenance
root_cause: Fields labeled supplier_verified have no cited source version or retrieval date
solution: Attach an authoritative supplier source with version or date before relying on the claims

title: Simulation measurement list has ambiguous YAML indentation
root_cause: The cable exit direction item is outside the apparent measurements_required list
solution: Correct and validate the source dataset without treating the correction as evidence

title: PO measurements conflict with simulation geometry
root_cause: The dry-run used synthetic watch and charger dimensions before PO measurements were available
solution: Use the 2026-07-26 PO measurements for planning and preserve all synthetic values as simulation_only

title: Fit geometry and clearances lack coupon evidence
root_cause: Pocket proposal channel variants clearances depth and body radii are provisional or unresolved
solution: Prepare Fit-Test Coupon CAD v0.1 only after PO approval of the exact plan acceptance of its limitations and named CAD authorization

title: Device side feature functions are unconfirmed
root_cause: Photographs show openings a pinhole and a cover but do not authoritatively establish their functions
solution: Confirm functions from an authoritative manual or PO test and preserve access meanwhile

title: Original photographs expose private device identifiers
root_cause: Some back-label photographs contain QR serial or IMEI information
solution: Keep unsafe originals out of the repository and provide sanitized back-label and charging-recess views; safe views are indexed in P001 evidence
